method: Each leg needed three things: a price within ~1.5–3¢ of the de-vigged fair line (DraftKings + Polymarket), Polymarket's top sports traders positioned on the same side (and not against it), and published expert analysis or news that agreed. Conflicts were dropped (e.g. LSU −5.5: experts for, top traders against; Oregon–Ohio State under: expert for, top-trader money on the over). The N-leg bet is the first N legs that haven't started yet.
honest: Every leg costs a little more than its fair chance (Kalshi's fee), so the expected return is slightly negative on paper, and it gets worse with every leg you add. These are the best-supported picks today, not guaranteed winners.

ladder.label: Denver Broncos −2.5
ladder.why: Denver is 6-2 on a four-game win streak and healthy; Carolina lost two straight, Bryce Young has more INTs than TDs over two weeks, and left guard Damien Lewis is out. Biggest top-trader position on the board backs it (≈$40k for vs $14k against). Priced within 1.3¢ of fair.

ladder.label: Syracuse Orange +2.5
ladder.why: Three of Polymarket's top sports traders hold Syracuse at this line with nobody against (≈$6k vs $0). Syracuse has won two straight as 8.5-pt dogs and beat Clemson last year as a 17.5-pt dog; Pickswise takes Syracuse outright. One of the closest-to-fair prices today (−1.0¢).

ladder.game: Western Kentucky Hilltoppers @ Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders
ladder.label: Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders
ladder.why: Largest one-sided top-trader position in today's college slate: ≈$58k on Middle Tennessee vs $1k against. Dimers' model also leans Middle Tennessee +2.5. Plus-money (≈+127) on a near coin flip.

ladder.label: Under 54.5
ladder.why: LSU's defense is 6th in SP+ and has held 6 of 8 opponents to 17 or fewer; Alabama averages 13.5 vs top-20 defenses. Covers takes the under at 52.5; this is the safer 54.5 number, where top traders also sit on the under (≈$1.7k vs $0.1k).
